metadata.description: Come play and "Experience A New Beginning" at Washington's #1 rated resort golf course! Golf at Desert Canyon,  located above the Columbia River and mid-way between Wenatchee and Lake Chelan. Tee time reservations may be made 30 days in advance. Our beautiful course is built for both competition and observation as the lush greens are surrounded by the beautiful Canyon view.  Onsite Accommodations allow you to enjoy the desert in spring, summer, fall and winter! The Great Links Resort at Desert Canyon offers luxury suites with living rooms, spacious bedrooms, and full kitchens completely supplied with all you need to make the lodge your home for a night or an extended stay. Come relax in the peace and quiet of the desert. One, two and four bedroom units are available. So come stay and play at the Desert Canyon Golf Resort!
